lead.tldr: Prediction markets face regulatory clarity crisis as insider trading definitions remain ambiguous despite CFTC's new enforcement focus and proposed rules. • IoTeX bridge exploit draining up to $8.8 million signals persistent smart contract vulnerabilities requiring enhanced security protocols across DeFi infrastructure. • Spot Bitcoin ETF outflows continue fifth consecutive week, marking first such streak since March 2025 amid broader crypto market sentiment collapse. • Traditional finance tokenization accelerates with BNP Paribas Ethereum pilot, validating institutional blockchain adoption despite current market downturn and risk aversion. • Russia sanctions evasion through five crypto exchanges processing $11 billion highlights regulatory gaps and geopolitical risks for compliant market participants. • Private credit market shadow defaults rising as capital oversupply chases lower-quality deals, mirroring risk concentration patterns emerging across crypto lending protocols.

top_signals.title: Prediction markets are bending insider trading rules. But will they break them?
top_signals.summary: Prediction markets, regulated by the CFTC as event contracts, face growing scrutiny over insider trading risks due to unclear definitions of material nonpublic information and the broad scope of available bets. Lawmakers, led by Representative Ritchie Torres, have introduced the Public Integrity in Financial Prediction Markets Act of 2026 to prohibit elected officials from trading contracts tied to administration policies, addressing demonstrated dangers like suspicious Polymarket trades before events such as the Maduro operation. CFTC Chairman Michael Selig signals imminent rulemaking to clarify insider trading rules while asserting exclusive federal jurisdiction against state encroachments, a development vital for institutional investors seeking compliance certainty amid rising retail volumes and platforms like Kalshi, Crypto.com, and Robinhood. No major U.S. arrests have occurred yet, but platforms monitor for manipulation and report to the CFTC, heightening the need for robust surveillance policies.

top_signals.title: IoTeX hit by private key exploit draining up to $8.8 million from bridge contracts
top_signals.summary: IoTeX suffered a private key exploit that drained up to $8.8 million from its bridge contracts. The co-founder claims the actual losses are lower than initial estimates but hasn't provided a specific number.

top_signals.title: Five crypto exchanges are helping Russia evade sanctions, filling Garantex's void: Elliptic
top_signals.summary: Five crypto exchanges are reportedly helping Russia evade sanctions, filling the void left by Garantex. One exchange processed at least $11 billion in crypto from the same building previously used by the sanctioned Garantex.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin Miner Bitdeer Liquidates Entire BTC Treasury, Holdings Fall to Zero
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin miner Bitdeer has liquidated its entire Bitcoin treasury, including both mined BTC and reserves, resulting in zero BTC holdings. This is an unusual move as mining companies typically maintain some Bitcoin exposure.

top_signals.title: In the $3 trillion private credit market, the ‘shadow default’ rate is increasing as more money chases lower-quality deals
top_signals.summary: The private credit market is experiencing an increase in 'shadow default' rates due to declining interest rates and high demand, leading to lower yields for investors. This situation is driven by the Fed's interest rate policies and an oversupply of capital chasing lower-quality deals.

top_signals.title: ProShares’ stablecoin-ready ETF posts ‘insane’ $17B trading debut
top_signals.summary: ProShares' stablecoin-ready ETF experienced a significant trading debut with $17 billion in volume. The SEC's 2% haircut guideline could potentially boost stablecoin adoption.

top_signals.title: Hungary says it will block the EU's $106 billion loan to Ukraine until Russian oil resumes flowing through a key pipeline that Moscow damaged
top_signals.summary: Hungary is blocking the EU's $106 billion loan to Ukraine until Russian oil resumes flowing through the Druzhba pipeline, which was damaged in a Russian drone attack. This action highlights the geopolitical tensions and energy dependencies impacting the region.

top_signals.title: BNP Paribas uses Ethereum for money market tokenisation pilot
top_signals.summary: BNP Paribas Asset Management has tokenized a money market fund using the Ethereum blockchain. This pilot program signifies traditional finance institutions' increasing interest in tokenization.

top_signals.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs notch five straight weeks of outflows for first time since March 2025
top_signals.summary: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs experienced net outflows of approximately $316 million during the Presidents' Day trading week, marking five consecutive weeks of outflows. This is the first time this has happened since March 2025.

top_signals.title: Crypto Market Gives Back Nearly All Gains from 2024 and 2025 in Round Trip
top_signals.summary: The cryptocurrency market has reversed nearly all gains from the latter half of 2024 and all of 2025. Investor sentiment is reportedly at record lows, indicating a significant downturn.

top_signals.title: DeXe whale accumulation hits ‘alarming’ rate: Is rally to $10 next?
top_signals.summary: DeXe is experiencing increased whale accumulation and a breakout, leading to speculation about a potential rally to $10. Futures traders are also leaning long on the asset.
